caption: Classical interpersonal circumplex state space
author: Timothy Leary; Donald J. Kiesler; Jerry S. Wiggins

stateSpaces.caption: Interpersonal circumplex
stateSpaces.description: Circular interpersonal state space representing behavior by angular position in the agency-communion circumplex and radial amplitude from the neutral center. The angle zero direction is positive communion, and angles increase counterclockwise toward positive agency.

angle.caption: Circumplex angle
angle.description: Angular position in the interpersonal circumplex.

radius.caption: Amplitude
radius.description: Distance from the neutral center of the interpersonal circumplex, representing the intensity of interpersonal behavior. The neutral center itself is excluded because the angular position is undefined at radius zero.

export.description: A momentary interpersonal state represented by circumplex angle and radial amplitude.
